text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Ines! I prepared a bunch 
of stuff today, so look forward to it even 
after we get back to the dorm!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A feast, cake, and then— that special 
thing starting with "P", among others!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You mean that thing that starts with 
"P"?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Could Ryan-chan possibly be...?\nCould 
she have prepared *that* thing...!?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a present! Because it's your 
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...Thank goodness!!!! It wasn't protein 
powder after all!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I put together my own special muscle 
training set! Let's keep giving it our 
best together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it...\nMaybe it really is protein, 
nooo-!!!!)
